seedText: A real-time news feed and microblogging platform where people share short posts, follow accounts, and discuss breaking news and current events.

Users report serious problems with account suspensions, poor customer service, unresponsive support, and concerns about platform content moderation fairness—though some praise the real-time news feed and social media network value.
